user.title: Connect Realtime Trains
user.description: Enter your personal NG API token from api-portal.rtt.io. Both access and refresh tokens are supported.

reauth_confirm.title: Update your API token
reauth_confirm.description: Your station and tracked trains will be kept.

error.invalid_auth: RTT rejected this token. Check that it is an NG API token with the required access.
error.rate_limited: The shared request allowance is exhausted. Please try again after it replenishes.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve valid data from Realtime Trains. Please try again.
error.no_stations: No supported UK stations are available with this token.
error.invalid_selection: Choose one of the listed stations.

abort.already_configured: Realtime Trains is already configured. Use Configure to add or remove trains.

manage_stations.title: Manage home stations
manage_stations.description: Choose one or more home stations. Removing a station from this list keeps its existing tracked trains until you remove them separately.

add_track.title: Find a train
add_track.description: Choose a home station and search arrivals or departures during the hour starting at this UK local date and time. Each choice tracks one dated train at that station.

choose_track.title: Choose a train to monitor
choose_track.description: Monitor this dated train at home. Optionally repeat it each week at the same UK local scheduled time. Timetable changes without a clear match need a new selection.

weekly_repeats.title: Weekly repeats
weekly_repeats.description: Selected trains repeat every week after arrival, departure or cancellation. Clear a selection to stop repeating and keep monitoring its current dated train. Existing trains may need one API lookup to verify their route.

error.invalid_window: Choose a valid UK local date and time within your token's permitted range.
error.invalid_auth: RTT rejected this token. Update it through the integration's authentication flow.
error.rate_limited: The shared request allowance is exhausted. Please try again after it replenishes.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve valid train data. Please try again.
error.no_services: No additional passenger trains match this search. Try another start time or direction.
error.invalid_selection: This selection is no longer available. Search again.
error.select_station: Choose at least one home station.
error.no_stations: No supported UK stations are available with this token.
error.cannot_repeat: The train's operator and route could not be verified. Select a current service with complete route data before enabling a weekly repeat.

abort.integration_unavailable: The integration is unavailable or reloading. Try again shortly.
